2027-01-23.title: Saturday of the Second Week in Ordinary Time
readings: The blood of Christ will purify our conscience
God mounts his throne amid shouts of joy
His family said: He has gone out of his mind
2027-01-23.alt: Weekday of Ordinary Time, Week 2 (Year I). Liturgical colour: green. Week of Prayer for Christian Unity (18–25 January). Optional: Saturday memorial of the Blessed Virgin Mary; St Marianne Cope (USA).
2027-01-23.verse: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without blemish to God, purify our conscience from dead works to worship the living God!
theo: Hebrews describes the old tabernacle with its Holy Place and its Holy of Holies, where the high priest entered once a year with the blood of animals. Then it announces the fulfilment: “when Christ came as a high priest of the good things that have come… he entered once for all into the Holy Place, not with the blood of goats and calves, but with his own blood, thus obtaining eternal redemption.” If animal blood could purify the flesh, “how much more will the blood of Christ… purify our conscience from dead works to worship the living God!”

Mark's Gospel today has only two verses. Jesus comes home, and the crowd is so great that “they could not even eat.” His relatives go out to restrain him, “for people were saying, ‘He has gone out of his mind.’” Total self-giving looks like madness to the world. The One who offered himself without blemish to God seemed foolish even to his own family. Love that gives everything always appears a little mad. On this Saturday we remember Mary, who stood by her Son when others did not understand.
outline: Ask: has anyone ever thought you were foolish for doing good?
Christ enters with his own blood.
From dead works to living worship.
His family thought he was out of his mind.
“The blood of Christ… purify our conscience.”
live: Make an examination of conscience tonight and plan confession.
Do one generous act that others may think excessive.
2027-01-23.prayer: Lord Jesus, you entered the sanctuary with your own blood and obtained eternal redemption. Purify my conscience from dead works, give me the holy madness of your love, and keep me near your Mother, who understood you when others did not. Amen.
altar: The chalice holds the Blood of Christ that purifies our conscience. At Mass we worship the living God with hearts made clean.

quick: Christ entered once for all with his own blood.
His blood purifies our conscience for living worship.
Total love looks like madness to the world.
2027-01-23.action: Make an examination of conscience tonight and plan confession.
2027-01-23.question: Am I willing to be thought foolish for love of Christ?

family.explain: So many people came to Jesus that he did not even have time to eat! Some of his relatives thought he was working too hard and wanted to take him home.
family.intention: We pray for people who work hard to help others.
family.ask: Ask: “Who works very hard for our family? Let us thank them.”

illus: When St Damien chose to live among leprosy patients on Molokai, some called him foolish and reckless. Some said the priest was either mad or a saint. Years later the Church answered: a saint. The madness of love is wisdom in God's eyes.

pm.open: Lord Jesus, your blood purifies our conscience. Make us clean and generous as we gather. Amen.
share: He entered once for all with his own blood (Hebrews 9:12). What does Christ's sacrifice mean to me?
Purify our conscience from dead works (Hebrews 9:14). What dead works weigh on me?
They said, He has gone out of his mind (Mark 3:21). Do I love generously enough to seem foolish?
interc: For a renewed love of the sacrament of Reconciliation.
For those who give themselves totally to others.
For families who misunderstand a member's vocation.
For our group, that our worship may be pure.
pm.close: Father, through the blood of your Son you purify our conscience. Make our worship living and our love generous. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, Hebrews takes us into the old tabernacle, where the high priest entered the Holy of Holies once a year with the blood of animals. Then: when Christ came as a high priest, he entered once for all into the Holy Place, not with the blood of goats and calves, but with his own blood, thus obtaining eternal redemption (Hebrews 9:11–12).

If animal blood purified the body, how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without blemish to God, purify our conscience from dead works to worship the living God! (Hebrews 9:14).
Today's Gospel is very short. So many people came that Jesus could not even eat. His relatives went out to restrain him, for people were saying: he has gone out of his mind (Mark 3:21).
Total love looks like madness. The One who gave his blood for us seemed foolish even to his own. Let us let his blood purify our conscience, and let us love with a little of his holy madness. Amen.
kids: Children, Jesus worked so hard helping people that he forgot to eat! Jesus loves us with all his heart. Let us love others with all our hearts too.

intro: Theme: “How much more will the blood of Christ… purify our conscience!”
The once-for-all sacrifice, a purified conscience, the madness of love.

q: He shall slaughter the goat of the sin offering that is for the people and bring its blood inside the curtain, and do with its blood as he did with the blood of the bull, sprinkling it upon the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.

But when Christ came as a high priest of the good things that have come, then through the greater and perfect tent (not made with hands, that is, not of this creation), he entered once for all into the Holy Place, not with the blood of goats and calves, but with his own blood, thus obtaining eternal redemption.
points.apply: Thank Jesus for his blood at the consecration this Sunday.

q: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without blemish to God, purify our conscience from dead works to worship the living God!
O LORD, you have enticed me, and I was enticed; you have overpowered me, and you have prevailed. I have become a laughingstock all day long; everyone mocks me.
When his family heard it, they went out to restrain him, for people were saying, “He has gone out of his mind.”
points.apply: Do one generous act others may find excessive.

concl: Christ's blood cleanses us for true worship.
His love looks foolish, and is the wisdom of God.
2027-01-23.resolve: Make a good confession before the end of January.
